about: Where each agent platform keeps its skills, commands, instructions and specs inside a folder (design §4.1) — paths only, the contents' meaning is not read. glob: '/'-separated, '*' within one name, '**' any number of folders. name: how an item is named when its file has no front matter name — 'dir' (the folder holding the file), 'file' (the file name), 'command' (the path under the commands folder, ':' between folders, no extension). frontMatter: the file may start with YAML front matter (name · description). runs: the file holds settings that run on the computer of whoever works in the folder (hooks, MCP servers, permissions). The server (server/lib/folders/kit.js) and the desktop preview (desktop/src/runner/sync.js) use the same file; desktop/src/runner/kit-places.json is a copy of server/lib/folders/kit-places.json. runsKeys (optional): for a JSON settings file, the keys (dotted) of which at least one must be there and not empty for it to count as runs — without runsKeys, runs is as given. The single source is server/lib/folders/kit-places.json. frontRuns: a skill · command · agent file runs something too when its front matter declares one of frontMatterRuns (Claude Code: hooks registered when it is used, tools approved without asking, its own shell · MCP · LSP servers, a permission mode) — the desktop leaves those keys off for a person who may not edit the folder (desktop/src/runner/runSettings.js); the badge reads them conservatively (a key of that name anywhere in the front matter).
